name: Derbyshire Dales District Council Local Plan 2013-2033

housing-numbers.notes: OAN of 5,680 dwellings for plan period. Allocated sites provide 2,485 dwellings without planning permission at 1st April 2017. Total housing provision of 6,684 dwellings provides 17% flexibility. Windfall allowance is 15 dwellings per annum 2017-2033. PDNPA contribution of 320 dwellings and sites with resolution to grant of 262 dwellings also included in overall provision.
